decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix is far from the firm's waste-to-energy plant business, and with no website evidence since 2019 its value as an option looks unlikely to be realized, so its resources are better redirected to the core plant technology.
The modular extensions complement the core WASTX plants and cost little to keep available as an add-on, so the option is worth holding open while demand for the base plants is still uncertain.

WASTX Oil is the flagship with its own page and a public launch, and decentralized waste-oil solutions still have uncertain but potentially large value, so the firm should keep it open rather than abandon it.
The plastic-to-fuel plant gained its own page in 2019 and shares the WASTX technology platform, so keeping it costs relatively little while the market for plastic-waste solutions develops.
